Your appointment destination

What to know before visiting from North Central Phoenix.

Appointments from North Central Phoenix take place at 6022 N 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help selecting a service or planning a group visit. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; available booking times may end earlier. Free on-site parking is available. Check the current menu and booking flow for service choices and starting prices.

View current menu →

Plan your visit · Aprés Gel-X

A complete Gel-X reservation begins with removal, not just the new design.

For a North Central Phoenix guest, the short route can tempt an underspecified booking. Gel-X still requires a complete scope: identify what is currently on the nails, reserve soak-off when needed, choose the new length and shape, report repairs, and allow for the finish and art. Gel-X uses full-cover soft-gel tips and does not follow an acrylic fill path.

Plan an Aprés Gel-X set →

Another option · Builder Gel / BIAB

Builder Gel serves a different maintenance decision.

Choose Builder Gel or BIAB when the goal is structured support or an overlay with an ongoing maintenance plan. Existing material and nail condition should be disclosed before the reservation is confirmed.

Plan Builder Gel or BIAB →

Compare services · Spa Pedicures

A pedicure tier should reflect the experience you actually want.

Essential grooming, Organic Spa, and longer rituals differ in time and care. Select the tier and finish instead of asking the artist to redesign the appointment after arrival.

Compare spa pedicures →

Build a complete Gel-X appointment before departure.

Include old-product removal, the intended length and shape, repairs, finish, and design complexity when booking Gel-X. Builder Gel and pedicure appointments should be selected separately according to the work needed.
